phrase: Regulators opened a probe into top AI companies over security incidents. That same week, a government leader's own edited photo was flagged as AI-made — by an AI detector.
phraseAlternatives: A government leader shared a photo that turned out to be AI-edited, flagged by an AI detector — the same week regulators began probing top AI firms over security incidents.
One agency started investigating top AI companies over security incidents. Another AI tool caught a government leader's own photo quietly faking reality.
AI companies are being investigated over security incidents that may have harmed people. Meanwhile, AI itself just caught a government leader editing a photo.

brief.concept: The same week regulators opened a security-incident probe into two major AI companies, a government leader's own edited photo got caught as AI-made — by an AI detector.
brief.metaphor: A detector built to catch fakes ends up catching the very people who are supposed to write the rules, while a second investigation quietly circles the companies accused of the underlying mess.
